@graph.name: Internet Service Provider Kenya | Filao Networks Solutions
@graph.description: Filao Networks is Kenya's top-tier ISP providing high-speed residential fiber, enterprise leased lines, 4K CCTV security, and managed IT services in Nairobi.

mainEntity.name: What internet services does Filao Networks offer in Kenya?

acceptedAnswer.text: Filao Networks provides residential fiber broadband (10 Mbps to 1 Gbps), uncontended enterprise dedicated leased lines, fixed wireless internet, and managed public Wi-Fi hotspots across Nairobi and Kiambu.

mainEntity.name: How fast is Filao Networks home fiber internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Filao Networks residential fiber delivers symmetrical and high-speed bandwidth ranging from 10 Mbps for light home use up to 1 Gbps for heavy 4K streaming, gaming, and remote work.

mainEntity.name: Where is Filao Networks fiber coverage available in Nairobi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coverage is currently active across Kasarani, Githurai, Kahawa Sukari, Kahawa Wendani, Ruiru, Roysambu, along the Thika Superhighway corridor, and surrounding Nairobi metro areas.

mainEntity.name: Does Filao Networks install CCTV cameras and security systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Filao Networks designs and installs commercial and residential 4K AI CCTV surveillance, biometric access control, smart video doorbells, and electric perimeter fencing.
